title: Experiment matrix runner
description: New src/run_experiments.py: matrix = arch {custom,resnet18} x strategy {sampler,class_weighted} x seeds {42,43,44} (12 runs total), moderate aug, early stopping, scheduler, two-stage for resnet18, checkpoint via model_factory. Dry-run (default) prints planned runs + writes plan json; --batch {custom,resnet18} --execute runs cells of one arch sequentially (approval required before --execute). Per run: checkpoint models/experiments/{arch}_{strategy}_seed{seed}.pth, metrics reports/experiments/runs/{arch}_{strategy}_seed{seed}.json with val acc/bal-acc/damaged-recall/FN + full hyperparams. Test manifest never passed to runner.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run lists 12 cells (2 arch x 2 strategy x 3 seeds) without training
--batch filter restricts execution to one arch
Each metrics json contains val_acc, balanced_accuracy, damaged_recall, fn_count, seed, hyperparams
